steps.en: Install the renderer and define components with property schemas
steps.zh: 安装渲染器，定义组件及属性约束

steps.en: Group the allowed components into a library
steps.zh: 将允许使用的组件组成库

steps.en: Derives model instructions from the component library
steps.zh: 从组件库生成模型指令

steps.en: Call your model on the server and pass its text stream to Renderer
steps.zh: 服务端调用模型，把文本流交给渲染器

steps.en: Parses arriving statements and renders your registered components
steps.zh: 逐步解析返回语句，渲染已注册组件

value.en: Interactive answers use your existing UI components instead of invented JSX imports
value.zh: 交互答案复用现有组件，不再依赖模型编造的 JSX 导入
